**What do you think about the initiatives on DE&I of your group?**

Rated separately on four aspects — gender balance, diversity, equity,
inclusion — from *Very Poor* to *Very Good*, plus *No interest* and
*Prefer not to answer*.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent.parent))
from _helpers import bar, load_univariate, suppression_note  # noqa: E402

RATING_ORDER = [
    "Very Good",
    "Good",
    "Poor",
    "Very Poor",
    "No interest",
    "Prefer not to answer",
]


def rating_bar(col, label):
    return bar(load_univariate(col), col, title=label, sort=RATING_ORDER)
```

## Gender balance

```{python}
# | echo: false
rating_bar("q12_genderbalance", "Q12. Gender balance (group)")
```

## Diversity

```{python}
# | echo: false
rating_bar("q12_diversity", "Q12. Diversity (group)")
```

## Equity

```{python}
# | echo: false
rating_bar("q12_equity", "Q12. Equity (group)")
```

## Inclusion

```{python}
# | echo: false
rating_bar("q12_inclusion", "Q12. Inclusion (group)")
```

Across all four aspects, *Good* is the most common answer, with equity and
inclusion rated somewhat more favourably than gender balance.
